info.cls_ename: Bachelor's Program of International Business Administration in English

description.describe_ch: 探討創新與創業的相關理論與知識，並從創業案例中解析創新商機與營運模式，並藉案例內涵，累積實務的能力，引導學生找出新商機、以及推動創新商業模式的機會。
description.describe_eh: This course will learn to apply best-practice approaches to designing, developing, and running innovation-driven, often globally orientated, business. It cover the process from generating new business ideas, developing and refining ideas, and designing the infrastructure right through to launching the business. The course  will collaborate student to develop real skills in analyzing business opportunities, and articulating these opportunities in multiple formats

targets.describe_ch: 理解創新與創業理論與應用，並找出新商機
targets.describe_en: Key concepts underpinning entrepreneurship and its application in the recognition and exploitation of product/ service/process opportunities.

Assessment 2: Group Presentation or Individual Essay (Students can choose) = 55%

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Please attend the course as much as possible. Please notify the teacher of any absences by e-mail. 
No listening to music - using headphones / earphones in class.
Phones need to be on silent. 
Please avoid talking when others are speaking / presenting. 
Please visit the iLearn page at least weekly to ensure you are updated and aware of any preparation required for each class.
